correctness.rationale: The energy-based reproducing-kernel identity K(x,x)=L^{-1} int R(x,y)dy-(2L^2)^{-1} int int R(y,z)dydz is rigorously obtained by centering the resistance formula. Parallel/series decomposition on cut-vertex loops gives q_l(t)=t(l-t)/l, with arclength integral l^2/6. Ordered pair integration yields J=LQ/3-T/6+b^3/3+b^2(A+C)+2ABC. The single-point integrals on left/right loops are constant+(L-l)q_l(t), so only antipodes of longest loops in each bouquet can maximize, while the strictly convex bridge profile excludes all bridge points. Hub comparison gives the displayed affine b dependence and strict exact phase crossing. Every equality function is a scalar multiple of the appropriate evaluation Green representer. A separate exact Kirchhoff Green solver checks 135 rational networks; finite checks corroborate, not prove, the universal all-positive-real assertion.

value.rationale: The exact mean-zero Sobolev H^1-to-C(G) embedding norm is a canonical sharp pointwise stability invariant of a metric network. This full positive-length family includes multi-loop resonators and an explicit bridge-driven switch in the set of all norming points, with a complete global equality classification. It gives constructive sharp constants where general Sobolev approximation estimates do not, with a mathematically motivated nonlinear dependence on network lengths and a discontinuous optimizer localization threshold.
